title: Have Your Way, after Darlene Zschech

details.title: Have Your Way
details.lead: The singer's line on the trumpet, as she sings it, in the record's key: it runs from concert A3 to C5 (written B3 to D5), well under G5, so nothing moves. Played straight, with her phrasing and her long notes.
facts: Have Your Way, as Darlene Zschech sings it on the recording you sent
The singer's voice, read note by note and straightened
F concert, G for the trumpet
Verse, chorus twice, second verse, chorus three times, bridge four times, last chorus
